content.title:
The shape
of the quiet.
content.deck: A study in type, space and the things we leave unsaid.
content.body:
A page begins before the first word. There is the edge of the paper, the space above a heading, the small interval between one thought and the next. These are not empty places. They are part of what we read.

Good typography gives attention somewhere to settle. A familiar letter becomes expressive through its neighbours; a line finds its rhythm through the space around it. Change one relationship and the whole composition begins to shift.

The grid is a useful promise, not a final answer. It gives different elements a common ground, then leaves room for a voice to emerge. A generous margin, an unexpected pause, a heading that reaches across a column: structure makes these choices legible.
content.quote: Space is not what remains. It is what makes the rest possible.
